claims.claim: 三昧真火 is a single-target spell associated with 火云术; use requires 火云术 >=20 and its listed MP cost is 30.
飞砂走石 is a multi-target spell associated with 火云术; use requires 火云术 >=30; the introduction lists 30 MP with an increase for multiple targets.
In battle Alt+W opens the spell list, Alt+E opens the item inventory, and Alt+D is defend.
Player and participating summon have separate commands within a round. A pet action is conditional on an actual participating pet and its ability to act.
